title: Document
description: A canonical, source-of-truth document record. It keeps source identity and access control adjacent to content metadata. The raw source object remains the immutable record; chunks, vectors, sparse terms, and graph edges are derived artifacts that can be rebuilt from it. Canonical shape from the Synapse design report; backs the document store and the POST /documents.ingest endpoint.

doc_id.description: Stable identifier of the document within its tenant.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant/organization. Enforced at the storage/query layer via row-level security.

team_scope.description: Teams the document is scoped to, layered on top of ACLs for team-bound retrieval.

source_system.description: Origin system the document was ingested from (the source of truth for permissions unless explicitly overridden).

source_uri.description: URI locating the document in its source system.

content_type.description: MIME type of the source content.

language.description: Primary language of the document (BCP 47 / ISO 639 code).

version.description: Source-content version stamp (e.g. a content hash or source revision). Derived artifacts are stamped with this so a rebuild can be explained later.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the document was created.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the document was last updated.

owners.description: Principals or teams that own the document.

acl.description: Queryable access-control list for the document. ACLs are enforced at the storage/query layer, not only in UI logic.

inherit_from_source.description: When true, effective permissions are mirrored from the source system (source-of-truth ACLs).

metadata.description: Free-form source/domain metadata (stored as JSONB). Additional properties are allowed.
